en: The image is a sepia-toned, vintage photograph featuring a woman in an elegant dress seated beside a young child. The background is ornate, with floral and animal print decorations. The woman has a large flower decoration pinned to her dress, and the child is dressed in an old-fashioned outfit. The text at the top identifies them as 'Principesa Maria si Printul Nicolae'. Additional ornate text is visible on the lower part of the dress, and there is a publisher's mark 'Edit. C. Sfetea, Bucuresti' in the lower right corner.
